Kiro CLI: which KYA replays were tested

Replays tested on Kiro CLI

No replay has run on Kiro CLI. All 51 replays ran on Claude Code only, so this page makes no claim about Kiro CLI.

What the Kiro CLI setup page says about coverage

Kiro decides which tools go through MCP. KYA gates the ones that do. A tool Kiro executes outside MCP is outside the gate. Do not treat this setup as full coverage of the agent.

Source: the Kiro CLI recipe.

Install

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
